name: agent-os
description: A host-independent project memory and operating protocol for legacy / high-ambiguity codebases. Scaffolds frontmatter-scannable task, error and decision docs plus source-of-truth docs, then makes them findable with relevance ranking and a per-project alias map. Keeps memory honest with linting, recurrence escalation, bounded-memory compaction and health checks. Shared Skills work across Claude Code and Codex, while ChatGPT can use Native Skills where available or a generated Project compatibility bundle.
